result.reason: The added clause reaches the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, data return within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter. It preserves the existing termination and perpetual-license provisions. However, it is not strictly minimal because it extends the return and deletion obligations beyond Customer Data to all Sparkling Confidential Information, and applying a machine-readable-format requirement to all Confidential Information may be overbroad or impractical. Otherwise, the operative language is professionally drafted.
